psychological_meaning: Lotus, a muted and earthy red, evokes feelings of groundedness, stability, and quiet strength. It suggests a connection to nature and a sense of history, offering a comforting and reliable presence. It can also represent a refined elegance and a subtle passion, suggesting a calm yet determined spirit.
